en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional humorous song, southern/eastern dialect (су = са/се, гу = го). Stanzas 2, 3 and 5 contain lines I am guessing at, marked 'my reading'; the joke seems to be that the rooster did not crow.

lines.en: - Hey Stojan, my neighbor,
why did you anger your wife, hey,
so that your hens are shut in,
the level yard, Stojan, unswept?
- Hey neighbor, Jovka of Kumanovo,

lines.cyr: да кажују, мори, ќе се смееш,
lines.lat: da kažuju, mori, ḱe se smeeš,
lines.en: if I tell you, hey, you will laugh,

lines.cyr: а да видиш мори, ќе ме жалиш,
lines.lat: a da vidiš mori, ḱe me žališ,
lines.en: but if you saw, hey, you would pity me,

lines.cyr: сал' на мужа, Јовке, да не кажеш.
lines.lat: sal' na muža, Jovke, da ne kažeš.
lines.en: only, Jovka, don't tell my husband (my reading).
Last night, hey, we lay down

lines.cyr: и за петла, мори, збор зборесмо.
lines.lat: i za petla, mori, zbor zboresmo.
lines.en: and talked, hey, about the rooster.

lines.cyr: Што не пое, мори, да не пукне,
lines.lat: Što ne poe, mori, da ne pukne,
lines.en: That he didn't crow, hey, may he burst (my reading),
all the neighbors', Jovka, crowed.

lines.cyr: Нит' се спие, Јовке, нит' стануе,
lines.lat: Nit' se spie, Jovke, nit' stanue,
lines.en: Neither sleeping, Jovka, nor getting up,
nor, sister, waiting for the dawn,

lines.cyr: а од муку, мори, не заспасмо,
lines.lat: a od muku, mori, ne zaspasmo,
lines.en: and from anguish, hey, we did not sleep,
barely, sister, did we wait for the dawn.
That's why my wife got angry,

lines.cyr: без појање куќу не гу бива.
lines.lat: bez pojanje kuḱu ne gu biva.
lines.en: without crowing the house is not right (my reading).
That's why the hens are shut in,
the level yard, Jovka, unswept.
